articleTitle: Repetitive Control Method for Suppression of Higher Harmonics in Supply Current of Subway Couches
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Moscow Metro has signal systems that ensure the safety of train traffic, such as automatic speed control system and centralization and interlocking systems. The traction electric drive of a metro train should not interfere with the operation of rail devices during standstill or movement. The main harmonics of the traction current are harmonics multiple of 300 Hz, appearing during rectification of the alternating voltage, and harmonics multiple of 50 Hz, in case of partial faults in traction substation. To reduce the influence of the harmonic composition of the traction electric drive, the frequencies encoding the information signals are chosen in intermediate ranges. However, during the movement of the train, the frequency of the motor and, consequently, of the currents change. Being superimposed on the main harmonic of 300 Hz, the amplitude of these frequencies can be amplified and create interference in the signals of automatic speed control and collision prevention control systems. This paper proposes an algorithmic way to reduce the harmonic composition of traction current, based on the repetitive control method. The algorithm was tested on the traction electric drive of a subway train couch and showed a 10-fold decrease in the harmonic amplitude of 300 Hz.

articleTitle: B2B-VSC 3-phase 4-leg output voltage stabilization in stand-alone microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article describes the structure of a mathematical model of an automatic control system (ACS) of a 2-level 4-wire voltage source inverter (VSI) as part of a back-to-back voltage source converter (B2B-VSC). The main task of the control is to maintain the set voltage at the output filter. Note that the power part of the VSI is made according to a four-wire circuit with eight transistors connected to the LC output filter. The VSI control system is represented in a Cartesian coordinate system d-q with an orientation along the vector of the output voltage, the position of which is set by the ACS. The control system consists of a channel for regulating the output current and VSI voltage. The proposed model allows to provide the required voltage on the load when working in an autonomous network. The installation of such a B2B-VSC will eliminate the dependence of the load voltage on the frequency of rotation of the generator and ensure the operation of the drive mechanism in optimal mode. In addition, the influence of the zero conductor reactor parameters on the duration of transients of the zero component and the overall effect on the total harmonic distortion coefficient (THD) of the current is considered.

articleTitle: Bald Eagle Search Optimization Algorithm For Economic Dispatch Problem With Renewable Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Economic Dispatch (ED) problem is one of the most popular issues in power systems whose goal is to find the optimal power output combination from all generating units to minimize the total operational costs while satisfying all constraints of the system. Due to environmental concerns, renewable energy (RE) sources such as solar and wind are potential choices since fossil fuel supplies are depleted, fuel prices are rapidly rising and emissions are increasing. As a result, the globe is moving toward renewable energy sources to replace the old power plants. This paper presents a new and very recent nature-inspired meta-heuristics method, called the Bald Eagle Search (BES) optimization algorithm to solve the ED problem including RE sources. Moreover, three case studies (3, 6, and 10 thermal units) as well as a case that consider RE sources with three thermal units are used to ensure the effectiveness of the BES algorithm. Finally, the results of the proposed algorithm are compared to other optimization methods such as WOA, GA, PSO, and GSA. All the analysis is completed by using MATLAB R2017a.

articleTitle: Stator Inter-turn Short-circuit Fault in 3-Φ Induction Motors: A Critical Observations
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)

authors.preferredName: S S S R Sarathbabu Duvvuri
Nadupalli P N Sai Sri Hari Chandana
authors.firstName: Nadupalli P N Sai Sri Hari

abstract: A critical analysis on stator inter-turn short-circuit fault in 3-Φ induction motor is presented in this manuscript. A good number of research papers related to abnormal induction motor models are available in the literature. It is believed to be a novel contribution, as researchers haven’t considered the realistic torque/speed behaviour for various induction motor models under inter-turn fault is presented here. Dynamic computations for different induction motors models are carried on using MATLAB R2022a software. The novel idea is verified with extensive simulation studies with various induction motors. The results and observations identified from this research are placed with utmost care.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Braking Mode of an Asynchronous Frequency Electric Drive with an Energy Buffer in the DC Link
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In this study, an asynchronous electric drive powered by a frequency converter with a DC link, storage capacitors of standard and increased capacity, and additional pulse and inductive elements connected between the rectifier and inverter are considered. A system with an additional relay control of the current supplied to the inverter input from previously charged high-capacity capacitors was studied. A comparative simulation computer modeling of systems of a frequency asynchronous electric drive with vector control, with various electrical connection schemes and parameters of storage capacitive elements and additional pulse and inductive elements in the DC link, was performed. The time dependencies of the variables characterizing the operation of the electric drive and the processes of charging and recharging capacitors in the frequency converter in the motor and brake modes were obtained. An analysis of the obtained dependences is carried out, and the influence of the parameters of the power part of the circuit under study on transient processes in an asynchronous electric drive is established.

articleTitle: Predictive Current Control Scheme for Post-Fault Operation of Nine-Phase-Based Integrated Onboard Chargers
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This paper outlines model predictive control (MPC) implementation to integrated onboard battery chargers (OBC) utilizing a multiphase EV-drive train. Unfortunately, as the number of phases increases, the adoption of MPC becomes more complex. Positively, the redundant phases facilitate the optimization of the control action. This research concerns the control of nine-phase-based OBC and its supplying/charging ability during vehicle-to-grid (V2G) and grid-to-vehicle (G2V) healthy and post-fault operations; one or more defective inverter legs are disengaged. During such circumstances, the aim is to provide a control scheme that guarantees balanced grid currents while preserving machine losses to a minimum at zero overall torque development. To transition between pre- and post-fault instances, the presented approach requires only a slight adjustment to the control mechanism. Restrictions and fault scenarios are addressed and evaluated via MATLAB simulations.

articleTitle: Real-Time Condition Monitoring of Power Transformers Using the Internet of Things (IoT) and Dissolved Gas Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Transformer health monitoring is important because transformers are critical components of electrical power systems. Transformers convert electrical energy from one voltage level to another, and they play a vital role in transmitting and distributing electricity. If a transformer fails, it can cause widespread power outages, equipment damage, and other problems. By regularly monitoring the health of transformers, it is possible to identify potential issues before they cause problems, which can help prevent outages and other disruptions. Additionally, regular monitoring can help extend the lifespan of transformers by identifying and addressing issues before they become severe. In this paper, a continuous Health Index (HI) monitoring system using the Internet of Things (IoT) is proposed. The proposed model is capable of being integrated into the Digital Twin (DT) of a transformer as well.

articleTitle: Development of an IGBT Driver Test Bench
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The electrical equipment needs testing after manufacturing. This can be done in the operational environment or using specialized test benches. The special test bench can help to examine all possible operation modes including fault conditions. This paper considers the design of an IGBT driver test bench. Each operating condition can be separately tested to ensure the manufacturing quality of the IGBT driver sample. The simulation results are provided for the fault condition tests.

articleTitle: Robust Control of an Electric Drive Based on the Method of Inverse Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The paper considers the construction of a robust control system using the inverse dynamics method. It is shown that the use of a robust controller can improve the accuracy and quality of the system and significantly reduce the influence of parametric and external perturbations on the quality of control.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Regression Models for PV Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Electric power production is a necessity and cannot be avoided. Thermal power plants are the primary sources of power generation, and they result in substantial emissions of carbon dioxide. Moreover, the depletion of fuels is also an issue of concern. As a result, solar energy is being promoted globally. The solar system’s behavior is stochastic and dynamic. A comparative study of the Poisson regression, Linear regression, and Lasso regression models has been done to predict the nature of such behavior and forecast the generated electric power by the solar plant, based on the weather parameters such as temperature, humidity, and luminous intensity. The Linear regression model predicts the output power of PV systems more accurately over the Poisson regression and Lasso regression models.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Lifting and Transport Mechanisms with Intelligent Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Starting and stopping of many mechanisms is a problematic phenomenon that causes a load on the mechanical and electrical part of the object. The use of standard regulators does not always make it possible to achieve the necessary starting characteristics and speed indicators of braking. The paper proposes the use of a regulator, the principle of operation of which is based on the rules of fuzzy logic. In the course of the research, a rule base was developed that reflects the functioning of a real object. A neural network controller with the ability to train the network and adjust it when changing the system parameters is proposed. Based on the analysis of several types of regulators, optimal indicators of the start and stop processes were obtained when a supervisor was introduced into the system. Use of the proposed regulators allows to ensure the stability of the control system.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Different State of Charge Estimation Techniques for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Electric Vehicle (EV) has recently been gaining a great market capital and therefore Battery Management System (BMS) for batteries have become a very crucial aspect for various parameter estimation and proper handling of battery in various environmental conditions. One of the main parameters estimations for BMS is State of Charge (SoC) estimation. The SoC helps to determine the capacity that is remaining inside of the battery at every instance of time and helps to predict proper remaining range and determine the performance of the electric vehicle. Therefore, proper SoC estimation becomes very crucial when it comes to EV. However due to nonlinear and time varying behavior of the battery it becomes quite complex to determine the proper capacity remaining or available in the battery. The modeling of battery, polarization effect on battery is discussed. A comparative study of SoC estimation is done using Open Circuit Voltage method, Columbs Counting method, Kalman Filter sing Matlab and Simulink.

articleTitle: Investigation of the stability of the electric drive of the rocking machine for oil production
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article shows a block diagram of an asynchronous electric drive with a frequency converter for oil production. A mathematical description of the dynamics of an asynchronous electric drive with a frequency converter is given in the simplest differential equations, as well as in symbolic equations. A novel program for the development of the transfer function of the system comprising an adjustable frequency converter and an asynchronous drive is offered to determine the stability of the system using the mathematical system MATLAB. The graph of transitions of an asynchronous drive and the transfer function of an asynchronous electric drive with frequency regulation are given.

articleTitle: Compressor acoustic profile improvement in preheating mode
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Quite operation of home appliances is one of the most significant criteria used by customers, when they select the exact device among several devices with similar functionality. In such circumstances, even minor noise, which happens quite rarely, may negatively impact on the choice of customers. Thus, makers of various device for home wage a war on every excessive noise. As a result, various methods for noise control became an attractive and popular topic, involving talented researchers. This paper studies acoustic noise in preheating mode of compressors, where motor does not rotate thus decreasing background noise. In these conditions other minor noises become notable and significantly impact noise profile of the compressors. In the preheating mode of compressor, the DC current is injected into motor windings warming them. This heat transfers through the motor parts and compressor shell to the oil located at the bottom of compressor. This operation is required in order to decrease oil viscosity and guarantee normal operation of mechanical part. However injected current produces noise, which is undesired and should be decreased as much as possible. This research proposes and analyzes several approaches to compressor preheating and select the most silent one.

articleTitle: Analysis of Transient Characteristics of Single-phase-to-ground Fault in Resonant Grounded Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The national distribution network widely adopts the grounding operation mode of neutral point arc suppression coil. Due to the compensation effect of the arc suppression coil, the single-phase ground fault line selection method based on the steady-state signal basically fails. According to the differences in the amplitude, frequency distribution, and polarity of the transient zero-mode current of the fault line and the sound line in the amplitude, frequency distribution, and instantaneous mutation of the fault, MATLAB is used to build two resonance grounding systems of 10KV pure overhead line and cable hybrid line, and simulation research is carried out to verify the correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Design and Experimental Validation of Dump Truck Active Safety System Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: As a result of experimental tests and operating experience of BELAZ mining dump trucks, it has been established that the active safety system in difficult driving conditions on haul roads is in great demand. Loss of control on a slippery road as a result of driver error can lead to a serious accident and costly mining equipment repairs. The article proposes control algorithms that use additional information from the front wheel sensors. This made it possible to significantly improve the dump truck controllability in driving conditions of poor wheel adhesion, preventing the dump truck from yaw and wheels block, reduce mechanical impacts on the transmission and structural elements of the vehicle. Adapt the dump truck active safety system characteristics to changes in driving conditions. The test results are shown on a BELAZ dump truck with a carrying capacity of 90 tons. They confirm the effectiveness of the developed control system in comparison with that currently used in serial products.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Configuration Thermoelectric Generators Systems at Different Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Renewable energy sources are those that broadly familiar use free power. Solar energy is highly available in hot environments. This paper is a comparative study examining the configuration of a thermoelectric generator using direct and indirect solar radiation in three different operating conditions. Panels are constructed using thermoelectric generator modules arranged with series and parallel connections. Their operating conditions are either by heating the hot area of a panel using solar radiation concentrated using a Fresnel lens, direct solar radiation, or with a flow of water supplied by a solar water heater (15 × 10 thermoelectric generator panels). All operating conditions are performed experimentally. It was found that the generated output electrical power of a two-pass water flow system is 66.35% higher than the direct solar radiation thermoelectric generator panel and Fresnel lens thermoelectric generator panel. The experimental work was done in the summer season in Iraq.

articleTitle: Estimation of Energy Efficiency of Technological Equipment of Small Compressor Stations During Utilization of Associated Petroleum Gas
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The problems of improving technological processes and energy efficiency of using equipment for the utilization of associated petroleum gas at existing oil and gas fields in Russia are considered. The ways of rational use of electrical equipment and technological installations at small compressor stations are proposed. An analysis of the operating parameters of compressor stations for gas transportation revealed low energy efficiency of using equipment due to a decrease in the volume of raw materials supply and a decrease in the efficiency of the installations. In order to optimize the operation of compressor stations of low separation stages, it is proposed to consider the possibility of changing the topology of the arrangement of systems by moving compressor units from existing facilities to newly commissioned ones, as well as to other existing facilities. As a result of the calculations carried out, the correctness of the proposed structural solutions and their validity from a technological point of view are proved. Examples of structural reorganization of compressor units operating modes at specific hydrocarbon production facilities are given.

articleTitle: On the Possibility of Using the Threshold Approach to Detecting the Failure of Bearings in an Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Bearing faults are one of the most common causes of induction motor failure. Often, motor vibration information is used to detect this type of damage. However, obtaining this type of information requires special equipment (external sensors) and there are difficulties in using this approach in mechanisms, the operation of which is accompanied by an increased level of technological vibrations. Fault detection methods based on stator current analysis avoid these drawbacks. Currently, there are many approaches to solving diagnostic problems using fairly complex methods. At the same time, it is also of interest to use relatively simple methods suitable for online use. The paper analyzes the possibility of using the simplest threshold approach for detecting motor bearing faults, based on the use of information about the stator current with wavelet analysis for primary signal processing. The possibility of motor bearing fault detection based on the analysis of changes in the standard deviation of the stator current signal in the case of a bearing fault is shown. The features of the choice of the standard deviation threshold value are considered.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Investigation of Digital Control System of Energy Storage Device for Frequency-Controlled Electric Drives
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In the paper the research results of digital single-loop control system for supercapacitor energy storage as an element of hybrid power supply of frequency-controlled alternating current electrical drive are presented. The integration of a supercapacitor energy storage device into the electric drive is made by using the bidirectional DC-to-DC converter. The description of laboratory testbench setup, structure and mathematical model of digital single-loop automatic control system are given. Mathematical simulation and experimental evaluation of the digital control system performance have been carried out.

articleTitle: Wireless Technologies in Service Maintenance of Mining Dump Trucks Traction Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The electromechanical transmission of a mining dump truck is a complex technical object with a large number of parameters for setting and monitoring, the quality and cost characteristics of the dump truck service largely depend on the convenience and efficiency of their implementation. To improve the quality traction electrical equipment of mining dump trucks service maintenance, a data transmission system was organized that provides remote work with control system units. The paper considers the scheme of data transmission, provides a description of the tool software for monitoring and configuring dump trucks electric transmission parameters. The system under consideration checked at the stages of testing and adjustment of the kits, is used in real operating conditions and allows to organize service maintenance of domestic-made dump trucks at a level that is not inferior to their best imported counterparts.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Stability of Autonomous Electric Power Systems in the Oil And Gas Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The research paper looks into the specificity of power plant stations and autonomous electric power systems that ensure stable operation of compressor stations of main gas pipelines. The reasons for the unstable operation of the head compressor station of the Sakhalin – Khabarovsk –Vladivostok gas pipeline are analyzed. The authors propose methods and technical means for modeling electric power systems and increasing stability at various operating modes. A complete model of the power supply system of the Sakhalin compressor station was created and verified by comparing simulated and real processes. The resulting model makes it possible to analyze the transient modes of operation of the power system in order to reconfigure the operation algorithms of automation devices to improve the reliability and stability of operation. The rational for using the Nyquist frequency criterion to examine the stability "in small" of electric power systems with various configurations is presented. As a result of the analysis of autonomous power supply systems of electric power systems, the main directions of scientific and technical work pertaining to the improvement of their stable work are outlined, the causes of emergency shutdowns of power plant units revealed, and practical solutions to eliminate and reduce their impact proposed.

articleTitle: Influence of the PWM Strategy on Total Harmonic Distortion at Small Values of Ratio Between Modulation Frequency and First Harmonic
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This paper discusses the effect of pulse-width modulation strategies on the total harmonic distortion of the currents with the same switching losses in 2-level voltage source inverter. Continuous and discontinuous pulse-width modulation will be considered. In the developed model, the voltage source inverter is connected to a permanent magnet synchronous motor. The impact of the modulation strategy on the torque ripples will be also considered. The simulation results showed that the total harmonic distortion is better for the discontinuous pulse-width modulation, but the torque ripples frequency is smaller in the continuous pulse-width modulation.

articleTitle: Implementation of a "Clear Prop!" Function in Propulsion Inverter of Electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The unmanned aerial vehicles and aircraft electric propulsion systems use propellers to create a lifting force or thrust. Over last years their penetration in our life is growing with the quadcopters for photography and filming, delivery services, and other applications. This rases a problem of safety when starting the propellers, and many solutions use sound generation by the propulsion motors to attract attention of human and warn him from being harmed by the blades. This sound is replacing the command "Clear Prop!"—a phrase said before a propeller is starting up by the pilot to ensure there is no one in the area of the propeller. The sound is generated by feeding the motor windings with some current having frequency in the audible range prior to start of the motors. This paper considers two implementations of the sound generation using melody and recorded sound. The melody is defined by notes or tones and their durations, and the sound is recorded as 8-bit mono pulse-code modulation data. The algorithms for implementation are presented as well as samples of the sound playback.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Processes in the Voltage Inverter as Part of the Starter-Generator System of the Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article presents the block scheme of the starter-generator system for aircraft. In the proposed model, the main source of electricity is the cycloconverter with natural commutation which operates in parallel with the voltage inverter. In the generating electricity mode the parallel voltage inverter performs the function of an active filter. An algorithm for the analysis of electromagnetic processes for a parallel voltage inverter as part of the starter-generator system is proposed. The switching functions for the transistors of inverter are determined by the spectral approach. Expressions for determining the voltage and current of the inverter are found. The spectrum of the inverter current is determined. The article presents the result of computer modeling of the system under study, which allows us to confirm the validity of the proposed method of analyzing electromagnetic processes in the parallel voltage inverter.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electrical Characteristics of Supply Network for a Group of Electric Drives With a Periodic Load: Operation under Different
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In the article, an electrical network of an enterprise, consisting of an infinite bus, a transformer and a group of electric drives with a periodic load, has been analyzed using a developed computer model. In the study the peak values of the rms current, the minimum voltage value, the analysis of the power and energy consumption has been used as performance indicators. The simulation considers a group of electric drives with a rectifier assembled according to the Larionov scheme and a group of electric drives with a common DC link operating with a periodic load with different shares of the generator mode using load working phase desynchronization. Analysis of the obtained results showed that an electric drive with a common DC link offers the lowest peak current value for any value of the share of the generator load mode. Moreover, it produces the lowest power consumption with generator mode shares from 20% to 80%.

articleTitle: Operating Experience of a Grid-connected PVS of UrFU in Annual Cycle
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article presents data from an experimental study of a photovoltaic system connected to the grid in the harsh conditions of a sharply continental climate in the Ural-Siberian region of Russia.

articleTitle: Frequency-Cascade Electric Drive System for Induction Motor Starting Torque Stabilization
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: It is necessary to stabilize the dynamic torque of the motor at the start of mechanisms with cyclical action, such as machine tools, which perform the machining of large cylindrical parts and require their rotation. The research carried out has shown that such requirements are met by the proposed system of frequency cascade electric drive, based on an induction motor with a phase-wound rotor and equipped with additional elements enabling the transfer of sliding energy from the motor-rotor circuit to the DC link of the frequency converter. A pulsed control system of the inverter input current and correction of the control signals as a function of the motor torque value determined by means of a torque observer is proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Current Control Options in High-Power Electric Drives of Rolling Mills
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the quality of different adjustments (like current, torque, speed) in high-power DC thyristor electric drives (with a capacity of more than 2000 kW), made using equivalent 12-pulse thyristor converters with parallel connection of valve sections through current-limiting inductor and three-winding power transformer. Modifications considered were ones with individual current controls for each valve section and with a total current control for these sections. The results of our analysis and Simulink environment modelling showed that the version with individual current control has a significantly lower (by 2-3 times) speed compared to the variant with a common current control. A decrease in the current control circuits speed leads to a decrease in the Automatic Speed Control System (henceforth ASC system) maximum speed in the electric drives in question. Recommendations on the use of different models of electric drive current (torque) control circuits for various types of rolling mills are also given in the article.

articleTitle: High Order Sliding Mode Control based on a New Terminal Strategy Applied on the Speed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In order to achieve high performance for a three-phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (PMSM) under the influence of the most difficult changes that occur during the PMSM operation and to overcome some problems faced while the application of the conventional sliding mode control (C-SMC), this present paper deals with a new terminal sliding mode control based high order strategy (HO-TSMC) applied on the PMSM speed and left the current loop control depending on the exponential reaching law based on a continuous approximation (ERL). HO-TSMC affords remarkable characteristics, including fast and finite-time convergence and its reaching law developer based on new design contributes to reducing the chattering problems afflicted by C-SMC. Furthermore, the applied technique has the robustness feature under the parameter’s variation like the stator resistance, the stator inductance, and the inertia value, disturbances like load torque applied and it contributed to giving good performance characteristics of PMSM speed, too. The obtained results by simulation prove the validity of the application of HO-SMC for ensuring a robust control of the studied PMSM with higher performance compared to the C-SMC.

articleTitle: Investigating the Operating Principles of Vehicle-to-Vehicle Charging
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Supporting the growing market demand for battery-operated electric vehicles requires significant investments in the charging infrastructure. Innovative technologies are continuously being implemented to reduce the impacts of fast charging stations on the utility grid. Vehicle-to-Vehicle technology was proposed to transfer the energy from a donor vehicle to a receiver vehicle. The technology demonstrated tremendous benefits for the grid operator. This research investigates the operation of charging stations while enabling this power trading technology. Two popular charging station topologies are modeled in MATLAB and studied based on the performance of the combined power converters. Results evaluation demonstrated the superiority of one configuration, especially in terms of reduced losses and enhanced performance. Regardless, the V2V operation was successfully conducted in both explored scenarios, and the power exchange process was maintained.

articleTitle: The Choosing of Supercapacitor Capacitance for Smoothing the Peak Loads in the Frequency-Controlled Tram Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The article considers the existing methods for calculating the capacitance for energy storage device. Two approaches to choose the capacitance of a supercapacitor for smoothing peak loads are described, energy diagrams and equations are given for both cases. In the approach proposed by the authors, the storage capacity is selected, based on the peak current setpoint, which is consumed from the contact DC power supply. The dependence of the capacitance from peak current is given. An example for determining the capacitance of a supercapacitor module for a frequency-controlled tram electric drive is described. The cost of energy storage devices is calculated. The methods of mathematical modeling confirm the high accuracy of capacitance calculation and illustrate the proposed approach to smoothing peak loads. It is shown that the capacitance of the supercapacitor in the second case is 9 times less, from which it follows that second method has advantages in the mass and price of energy storage device.

articleTitle: Induction Motor PHiL-Simulator Reactor Parameters Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Real-time systems are used by the electric drives developers to develop circuit solutions, commissioning and test converters. Such systems are called Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) and Power Hardware-in-the-Loop (PHiL) simulators. During the PHiL development process it is necessary to choose the power part parameters like simulator reactors active resistance (R) and inductance (L). The paper discusses issues related to the choice of AC electric drive PHiL-simulator reactors parameters. Simulator current RMS values estimating for a number of operating points of the selected asynchronous motor mechanical characteristic is given.

articleTitle: System analysis of methods for correcting the parameters of the system "ideal current source - asynchronous motor"
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: The study of electromechanical systems based on Induction motors remains relevant, since this is the most popular type of converters. The article provides a systematic analysis of the entire range of converters, provides a rationale for the use of vector control systems in order to obtain the most energy efficient systems. The system of assumptions under which the dynamics of an Electromechanical system can be described using the mathematical apparatus of a standard oscillatory element is analyzed. For him, the most optimal way to correct the transient process of this element has been empirically identified. It has been successfully applied to the "ideal current source - Induction motor" system.

articleTitle: Aluminium-Sulfur Batteries: A low-cost Alternative to Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Long-term energy storage technologies are essential as energy demand grows globally. Due to the limited availability of Lithium, it is now necessary to look for alternatives to Lithium-ion (Li-ion) batteries. The present article describes Aluminium-Sulfur (Al-S) batteries, a powerful contender beyond the Li-ion domain. Both Aluminum and Sulfur are cost-effective and highly abundant elements on Earth. Al-based batteries may have a higher energy density than Li-ion batteries, which are monovalent, due to the triplet of Aluminium. With the increasing demand for electric vehicles (EVs), these batteries can be used at charging stations with the ability to charge faster.

articleTitle: Effect of Angle of Attack on Icing of Vertical Axis Wind Turbine Blades
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: In recent years, more attention has been paid to the research of vertical axis wind turbine blade icing, and this paper investigates the effect of angle of attack of incoming flow velocity on blade icing based on numerical simulation methods. The results show that the wind turbine has the best aerodynamic performance when the angle of attack is near 9°. The maximum icing thickness on the blade surface is positively correlated with the water collection efficiency, and the larger absolute value of the angle of attack, the larger the icing area on the blade surface.

articleTitle: Characterization of Electric Power Quality at the Grid-Connected Solar Power Station
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Possibility of parallel operation of solar power station with power system is considered in this paper. Power quality parameters of a photovoltaic system according to GOST are analyzed. Frequency and voltage deviations graphs are presented.

articleTitle: Reducing Starting Currents on the Mechanism for Moving Goods
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Mechanisms for moving goods are widely used in various areas of the national economy, as well as at industrial facilities. Improvement of existing control systems without deep reconstruction allows to reduce financial costs. The study of control systems in the Matlab Simulink mathematical modeling environment does not require additional costs, while it allows you to evaluate a particular control system in terms of achieving the required indicators. Significant inrush currents are a common problem in systems running continuously at full load. The paper analyzes control systems for mechanisms of this kind with the search for the best option.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Bearing Fault Detection of IM Fed by Variable Frequency Drive Using Motor Current Signature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: This work presents machine learning-based bearing defect detection of three-phase induction motor fed by variable frequency drive. Multi band-pass filters, fast Fourier transform (FFT) and machine learning algorithms have been used to detect whether or not the bearing is damaged based on the Motor Current Signature Analysis. The proposed method is developed using acquired stator current data from a simulation model, subjected to healthy and faulty cases under different operating frequencies and motor loadings. The inverter-fed motor monitoring is much noisier than the utility-driven motor, which could hide fault signs and result in an incorrect fault classification. Multi band-pass filters and FFT are applied to extract features from stator current signals and feed them to machine learning classifiers to detect the fault. The results showed that the proposed method could provide an accurate diagnosis of the bearing health of the induction motor.

articleTitle: Supervised Grid-supporting Droop Controllers for Islanded Microgrid Operated by Scattered Parallel Inverters
publicationTitle: 2023 XIX International Scientific Technical Conference Alternating Current Electric Drives (ACED)
abstract: Isolating parts of the electricity grid and certain load networks has become a standard practice in the grid management system nowadays. These isolated sections are configured as islanded Microgrids, and they must sustain their operation based on locally integrated resources like battery systems. In this article, a supervised grid-supporting droop controller is considered for a battery-operated islanded Microgrid. Battery systems are connected to inverters working in parallel to share the load power demand. The proposed supervisory controller achieved synchronization of the parallel inverters, while the droop-based controllers retained their decentralized characteristics and regulated the voltage and frequency of the Microgrid. The obtained results verified the effectiveness of the design in maintaining the power-sharing process even when a disturbance load was subjected to the Microgrid.
